title: Confirmations say exactly what happened and link to it
gap: Several toasts describe something that did not happen. Crew 'Add to Boards' writes a Rig scene node (app/api/crew/solutions/[id]/route/route.ts) but toasts 'A draft frame is on Boards' and opens Storyboards, where the node never appears (CrewView.tsx:73). 'Open in Gen' says 'paste it as the prompt' although Gen pre-fills it (CrewView.tsx:78). Business and Viral say 'It is in Takes and in Library' without refreshing the library. Cast's toast counts proposals, not the entries actually added (CastStage.tsx:105). Retry claims 'same inputs'. Held takes read 'Held for approval'.
target: Each toast names what was actually done and carries an 'Open' action to where the result really is. Crew either writes a real Storyboards frame or says 'Added to Rig' and opens Rig. Counts come from actual results. Add a unit test that checks each toast's destination matches the page it opens.
